name: @ttsc/station
description: Standalone TypeScript-Go compiler, runtime, plugin host, and LSP host workspace.

scripts.test: pnpm run test:go && pnpm run test:units
scripts.test:go: go -C packages/banner test -count=1 ./... && go -C packages/evidence test -count=1 ./... && go -C packages/lint test -count=1 ./... && go -C packages/paths test -count=1 ./... && go -C packages/strip test -count=1 ./... && go -C packages/ttsc test -count=1 ./...
scripts.format: pnpm run gen:flags && prettier --write "**/*.ts" "**/*.md" "**/*.mdx" && pnpm run format:go
scripts.experimental: pnpm package:tgz -- --current && pnpm --dir experimental/install start -- --skip-pack && pnpm --dir experimental/test-unplugin start -- --skip-pack
scripts.package:latest:publish: pnpm --filter=./packages/* --filter=!ttsc -r publish --tag latest --access public --no-git-checks --provenance && pnpm --filter ttsc publish --tag latest --access public --no-git-checks --provenance

author: Jeongho Nam
